title: thalictrum minus var. saxatile
intro: Thalictrum minus var. saxatile, commonly known as meadow rue, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, reduce stress, and protect against cell damage. Therapeutically, meadow rue is used to treat various conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual issues, due to its sedative and emmenagogic effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities.
